items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: one of the professors in town, uh, by the name of, uh, Paul Getze... we had a little orchestra there, and we played light classics

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And, uh, what kind of music do you remember hearing first over there?

Well, uh, my mother was a piano teacher, and, uh, the, one of the professors in town, uh, by the name of, uh, Paul Getze, late Paul Getze, uh, is a, he was a, a German-born, uh, professor, and very well schooled. And, uh, we had a little orchestra there, and we played light classics, of, uh, maybe, uh, type of humorous and, and, uh, barcarole and things like that.
